name: Your feather, my wing
source:
"Your feather, my wing" is a game about getting close to the object of an experiment that your 'super-secret lab' leads! it's all about fun, fluff and cuddles. nothing serious happens at your complex, and if anyone from the "normal world" came to this organization, they'd be disappointed by the lack of pathos, mystery and seriousness. but do you care?

[From [url=https://finier.itch.io/your-feather-my-wing]itch.io[/url]]
